name: Humanly Possible
inspiration: The Humanly Possible show brand (AIS Media; Pulse Combined palette, Mark B logo, gradients from the brand site artifact) combined with motion moves analyzed from Patriot Act, Hot Ones, The Diary Of A CEO, Colin and Samir, Ali Abdaal, Apple (Mac Students) and Great Big Story. Analyses and hero frames in references/.
summary: DEPRECATED 2026-11-03: rejected by Aidan (edge-stripe lower thirds, outline boxes, offset shadows read as AI-made). Replaced by 14-humanly-possible-v2. Kept only as history; do not select cards from this style.

palette.notes: Oxblood ground, cream type, brick for aside fields and feature surfaces, ONE orange per frame, ONE gold (a number or a word) per frame, deep for scrims only. The burn radial is the only full-field gradient; noise fill/flow/pass for one hero element. No other hues.

fonts.notes: Bricolage Grotesque 800 opsz 96, tracking -0.03em, sentence case. Inter Tight 500-700 for text, 600-700 tracked caps for labels. No brand mono; prompts and AI output set in Inter Tight 500.

motion: Pop and settle on cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) (GSAP CustomEase 'hpPop'), 0.18-0.45 s, scale from .92-.96, up to 12 px rise. Type holds still once landed while the ground drifts 2-6% on its own layer. Animate the light, not the layout (pass sweeps, cream-to-gold flips, icon ignites). Boxes are born from a line and collapse back to one. Words land on their spoken word (data-at). No bounce, spins or fades over 0.3 s. Deterministic grain stepped at 12 fps.
transitions: Graphics belong to the edit: most exits happen on the cut; animated exits mirror the entrance in 0.25-0.3 s. Asides hard-cut to the brick field. Chapter boundaries can use the seeded flat-block mosaic behind a camera cut. Never whips or chrome streaks.
